prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1294; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightness. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the presentation is entirely plausible for a collision of this type. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of motion, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain in the same region, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not affect the current assessment. Over the course of fourteen visits, treatment followed a standard conservative protocol including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Care tapered gradually as pain decreased and function improved, and the patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise. Billing for the episode reflects one charge per scheduled service with no repeated or duplicate entries.
